scheme_name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
other_conditions: Individual growers or farmer groups must have suitable land and facilities for irrigating the nursery
Units must be allocated in multiples of 500 with a minimum of 1000 and a maximum of 5000 units per beneficiary
Farmer groups must be a legal entity such as a registered Society, FPC, FPO, SHG, or SPS
Planting materials produced must be used for replanting by the applicant, with any surplus supplied to neighboring or needy farmers at a price not exceeding the market price
Eligibility is confirmed through inspections and follows a first‑come‑first‑serve basis for sanction
benefits_summary: 33.33% subsidy up to ₹3 per seedling for the general category and 75% subsidy up to ₹6.75 per seedling for SC/ST beneficiaries.
